'''Manta RamAir''' was a small manufacturer of [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]], including the [[Mk IV Flat Twin Turbojet/Legends|''MARK IV'' Flat-Twin Turbojet]] podracer.

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article "[[Insider's Guide to Star Wars Episode I]]," the maker of the Mark IV was named '''Mantis Ramair'''.
